              Settings

              Building cleanup

              Bumps and notches smaller than this are smoothed away. It measures how far a wall sticks in or out. Raise it for simpler shapes, lower it to keep small details.

              No building line in the DXF is shorter than this. A short jog is removed by running the walls on each side until they meet. The default is 5 ft. Only buildings cut by the edge of the site box can still have shorter lines.

              If a building fills at least this share of the rectangle around it, it is drawn as that plain rectangle. At 92%, a shape that is 95% box becomes the box. Lower it for more boxes; 100% never snaps.

              Buildings closer than this become one outline, like a house and a garage built almost against it. At 0 only footprints that touch are joined.

              Past checks

                Worked out from the tokens each answer reports, at Anthropic's list prices. The exact bill is at console.anthropic.com (Usage and Cost).

                With a key, AI check sends a smaller copy of the site photo (with the outlines drawn on it) to Anthropic, and Claude says which outlines are off and what is missing. Billed to the key's account: most of the cost is Claude's thinking and answer, so a check with many findings costs more (roughly 10 to 40 cents). Each check shows its cost. The key is kept only in this browser. Get one at console.anthropic.com.

                PDF and PNG

                The sheet uses the View style: Photo, Lines or Print. Only layers with the eye on are shown.

                Files

                Your edits

                Edits are saved in this browser for each site. Save them to a file to keep a copy or move them to another computer.
